enrichment.summary: Under a state law that requires districts to offer space to charter schools (Proposition 39), Urban Montessori Charter School will use classrooms at the Sherman campus for the 2019-20 school year, serving grades TK to 3. The district will receive $77,352.66 in annual revenue. The agreement is for one year only.
